counterfactual_missing_items: central punctum or skin adherence (not described)
decisive_items: a solitary, 4 × 3 cm, well-defined, firm, non-transilluminating, non-tender nodule
response.rationale: R5 best fits the raw description: a well-defined, firm, non-transilluminating, non-tender nodule with no trauma and no skin adherence favors a subcutaneous lipoma. R6 shares the firm non-transilluminating nodule but is weakened by the absence of trauma and lack of skin adherence. R4 is undermined by non-transilluminating; R1 by skin adherence and size; R2 by no trauma; R3 has no raw support.

rejected.why: Non-transilluminating is a key negative for ganglion cyst; dorsal location alone is insufficient.
Dermatofibroma is typically smaller and adherent to overlying skin, contradicting the non-adherent 4 cm nodule.
Keloid requires trauma, which is explicitly absent.
No raw support spans; pilomatrixoma is rare and not suggested by the vignette.
